note: Integrator findings corrected, reviewed and validated; exact full-suite/mechanical-cleanup boundary, corpus parity and final gate are in README.md and validation-run.json.

findings.finding: The reuse regression mocked run_step and bypassed the supervisor; the stopped-before-spawn boundary also needed a distinct control.
findings.requested_resolution: Execute actual harmless children on reuse, and assert no Popen after stop.

findings.finding: A failed preparation fell back to project_unit and retried validation; a transient failure could produce a report inconsistent with rejected compile-task identity.
findings.requested_resolution: Retain the original error in projection and prove a failing-once compiler cannot retry to Safe.

findings.finding: Certificate-scope integration could add a second marked preprocessing pass to Safe issuance.
findings.requested_resolution: Construct scope evidence from the immutable prepared snapshot.

findings.finding: A self-carried inventory digest alone establishes consistency, not the caller intended scope.
findings.requested_resolution: Provide independently derived caller context and reject coherent smaller-certificate substitution.

findings.finding: Initial Lean statements were concrete witnesses only.
findings.requested_resolution: Prove general coverage and expected-context containment for arbitrary certificates in addition to concrete controls.

findings.finding: Retained text hashes omit request options that can change interpretation without changing text.
findings.requested_resolution: Bind relevant ordered request options and clearly separate artifact scope identity from complete compiler provenance.

findings.finding: Early artifact-digest rejection short-circuited existing semantic mutation tests and changed their pinned refusal reasons.
findings.requested_resolution: Preserve semantic replay and its pinned diagnostics, while enforcing all new identity checks before acceptance.

independent_integration_review.scope: failure retention, actual stage metrics and retained certificate evidence adapter
